in_hindi.name: Bhalendra
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of strength and courage
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhalendra एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bhalendra is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: ‘Bhal’ meaning strength or power and ‘Indra’ representing the king of gods, Lord of the sky and weather. The name Bhalendra signifies one who possesses immense strength, courage, and is the ruler of his domain.
